page_title: CHE 0-1 NEW | Chelsea v Newcastle 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Paul Tierney is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' The attendance for today's match is 39857.
90+8' Cole Palmer drives to the by-line and dinks a lovely cross into the middle of the box. Joao Pedro (Chelsea) wins the ball but his header is just over the bar.
90+7' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea).
90+6' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
90+4' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+3' Reece James (Chelsea) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
90+2' Referee Paul Tierney sees the trip by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Chelsea have a free kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
89' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd). The referee is firm and issues Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) a deserved yellow card.
89' Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Paul Tierney signals. Newcastle earn a free kick.
89' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
88' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:1. 0:0 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
87' The corner from Reece James (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.

87' It could have been a good chance to score! Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) fails to release Alejandro Garnacho with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Chelsea.
86' Cole Palmer sends a terrific cross into the box. Liam Delap (Chelsea) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the left post.

84' Aaron Ramsdale (Newcastle Utd) obviously intended to delay the restart of play and the referee blows the whistle. Aaron Ramsdale (Newcastle Utd) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
82' Substitution. Wesley Fofana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jorrel Hato (Chelsea).

82' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Robert Sanchez is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
79' Reece James delivers a perfect cross for Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
79' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
78' That looked a certain handball by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
78' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) replaces Jacob Murphy.
77' Eddie Howe is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) suffers an injury and Dan Burn comes on.
75' Liam Delap (Chelsea) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
75' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
74' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
71' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
70' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Robert Sanchez comes off his line to gather the ball.

69' A neat pass is well received by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top right corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
69' 15:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 3:4.
68' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Chelsea.
67' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) comes onto the pitch for Nick Woltemade.
66' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Chelsea will take a throw-in.
66' Reece James (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
63' PENALTY APPEAL after Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' Substitution. Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Moises Caicedo walks off.
60' Reece James (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

60' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Chelsea force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Reece James (Chelsea) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
58' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

54' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Cole Palmer was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
53' Poor challenge! Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for tripping and Paul Tierney blows his whistle.
51' That's unlucky! Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
50' The resulting corner from Reece James (Chelsea) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
49' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
49' A snap shot by Liam Delap (Chelsea) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale produces a good save to thwart him.
47' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Liam Rosenior probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Malo Gusto. He is replaced by Liam Delap (Chelsea).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle Utd) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Robert Sanchez, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' The foul by Reece James (Chelsea) was seen by Paul Tierney who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
44' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) attempts to release Anthony Gordon with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
42' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Aaron Ramsdale intercepts the ball.
42' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) picks out Joe Willock with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
40' Reece James (Chelsea) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post!
38' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
38' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) tackles a bit over-zealously and Paul Tierney blows for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a free kick.
37' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Aaron Ramsdale is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
37' Reece James (Chelsea) sees his long-range effort blocked.
35' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Newcastle, play can continue.
35' Referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
34' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.
34' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Robert Sanchez punches the ball away. The ball is out of play. Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner.
32' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Aaron Ramsdale, who smothers the ball.
32' Some neat passing and movement from Chelsea as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
30' He should have scored! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
29' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
29' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Harvey Barnes. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
28' Chelsea keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
25' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

24' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
23' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
22' A pass from Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is intercepted by Aaron Ramsdale and the move breaks down.
22' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) sends a low pass from outside the box to Enzo Fernandez. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
21' Malick Thiaw (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Paul Tierney stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
20' 6:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:1.
18' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Joe Willock sprays a pass out to Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
16' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) blazes well wide of the right post.
16' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) got the ball on the edge of the box and produced a strong shot, but one of his teammates was standing in the wrong place and unintentionally blocked the effort.
16' The ball possession is 64:36.
14' Malo Gusto sprays a pass out to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post.

13' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Aaron Ramsdale allowed him to make a comfortable save.

12' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. A rebound falls kindly for Reece James (Chelsea), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
10' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle.

9' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
9' The referee awards a corner and Reece James (Chelsea) goes over to take it.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Reece James (Chelsea).
8' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Chelsea have a corner.
7' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Chelsea will take a throw-in.

5' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) smashes the ball upfield and Harvey Barnes brings it down with a fine first touch. A pass from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
5' Great teamplay by Chelsea as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
3' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

2' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Newcastle will kick the game off.
Paul Tierney is the one to supervise the game today.
